metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Quillstack (developer documentation platform); Platform: Google Cloud, global external HTTP(S) load balancer (url-map docs-prod, referred to as docs-lb) in front of managed instance groups in europe-west4 and us-central1; Instance subnets: 10.164.0.0/20 (europe-west4), 10.128.0.0/20 (us-central1); Backend service: docs-web-backend; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which component returned the failing responses to clients?
What load balancer status detail was logged for most failed requests?
Were the backend instances unhealthy during the incident? Answer yes or no.
What is the cloud provider's incident number?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change is a red herring that explains only the application 500 errors? Provide its change identifier.
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
